THIS WEEK IN LOCAL GOVERNMENT

The Weston Village Board approved a $6.7 million contract to build a new Mountain Bay Metropolitan Police Department facility, and residents heard early details of a potential $81–94 million DC Everest school referendum slated for April 2027.

  • The Weston Village Board voted 7-0 to award the Mountain Bay Metro Police Department building contract to 8 Pine Inc. for $6.7 million, under the $7 million budget.
  • Weston and Rothschild are set to finalize an intergovernmental agreement in August before signing with 8 Pine, targeting a late-September construction start.
  • The Weston Finance and HR Committee recommended the board approve a 36-month Cintas uniform renewal and a one-year audit contract extension with Hawkins Ash for 2026.
  • Kronenwetter's Parks Committee recommended the village board approve a September 12 Bushka Park 5K/3K run-walk as an official village event and contribute a $5,000 matching grant.
  • Kronenwetter's Plan Commission is set to vote on rezoning Marathon County Highway Department property from B3, SF, and AR to M2 General Industrial and act on related survey maps.
  • Kronenwetter's Administrative Policy Committee was scheduled to adopt a 2027 budget timetable and consider a budget adjustment for the municipal garage and bike path sealing project.

Coming up: The Marathon County Board meets Tuesday, July 28, for its full county board session, while the Wausau School Board's Education and Operations Committee convenes Monday, July 27 — both worth watching for major policy or budget action.
